title: Subdomain Migration
subtitle: The subdomain feature has been removed. This screen migrates any remaining subdomains, along with their files, into independent domain accounts — each gets its own Linux user, PHP-FPM service, FTP and database account.
empty_desc: There are no subdomain records on this server. Nothing to do.
warn_body: For each record a new Linux user is created, files are copied into the new account's public_html, and the old nginx config plus the A record in the parent zone are removed. The source directory is LEFT on disk so you can roll back if something goes wrong. nginx is validated once at the end; if validation fails no reload happens. Run the dry run first.
confirm_run:
{{count}} subdomain(s) will be moved into independent domain accounts.

This copies files, writes nginx configuration and deletes a DNS record. Continue?
symlink_warn: ⚠ contains symlinks, shared file links may break
